D/ CONSTANTINVS [IVN NOB C] ; R/ GLOR IA EXER ITVS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), Gloria Exercitius issue of 333-334, Lyon mint, Reece period 17, probably RIC vol. 7 no. 263. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS [IVN NOB C]. Reverse description: two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: GLOR IA EXER ITVS. In exergue: *SLG. Diameter: 16.4mm, Weight:…
